sections.title: What exists
sections.content:
- **landing.spec.ts** — 14 tests: static content, link presence, CDN check, page source assertions
- **legal.spec.ts** — 15 tests: section counts, headings, email links, navigation, dark theme
- **web-app.spec.ts** — auth screen only: inputs visible, branding, form interaction, font/color checks

sections.title: 1. AI prompt building (core product differentiator)
2. Rate limiting with optimistic lock
3. Offline queue deduplication
4. Milestone awarding logic
5. Chat edge function — input validation
6. Web app — post-auth screens (E2E)
7. Landing — CTA destination and mobile viewport
8. Auth form — validation edge cases
9. `buildCoachContext` — data assembly
Summary table
sections.content:
| Gap | Severity | Type | Effort |
|-----|----------|------|--------|
| `buildSystemPrompt` / personality voices | Critical | Unit | Low |
| `checkMessageLimit` optimistic lock | Critical | Unit | Medium |
| Offline queue deduplication | Critical | Unit | Low |
| `checkAndAwardMilestones` thresholds | Critical | Unit | Medium |
| Chat function input validation | High | Integration | Low |
| Post-auth screens (CoachScreen etc.) | High | E2E | High |
| `buildCoachContext` data assembly | High | Unit | Medium |
| Landing CTA destination | Medium | E2E | Low |
| Mobile viewport rendering | Medium | E2E | Low |
| Auth form — invalid email/password | Medium | E2E | Low |
| OG meta tags | Low | E2E | Low |
| `drainOfflineQueue` concurrency guard | High | Unit | Medium |

The biggest blind spot is the entire AI personality system — `prompts.ts` contains the product's core value and has zero test coverage. A regression there (wrong personality voice, missing forced references, Monk Mode not activating) would silently ship to users.
